summary: krffs_fuse_hosttest.c, the FUSE driver over an image file, with faults in private copies of the FUSE driver and the KRFFS library; the test is compiled with a fuse.h that stops the build, so that it uses its own stub

argv:
set -eu
t=${WORK}/tree
sh tests/proofs/tree.sh "$t" ${SRC} krffs tests/host
mkdir "$t/no-fuse"
printf '#error "krffs-fuse-test: test stub was not selected"\n' > "$t/no-fuse/fuse.h"
test=tests/host/krffs_fuse_hosttest.c
deps=$(sed -n 's/^.*host-deps: *//p' "$test" | tr '\n' ' ')
extra=$(sed -n 's/^.*host-cflags: *//p' "$test" | tr '\n' ' ')
cd "$t"
exec ${CC:-cc} -std=c99 -D_DEFAULT_SOURCE -D_FORTIFY_SOURCE=0 -DRACH2_HOSTTEST -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all -g -O1 -Wno-empty-body -ffreestanding -I krffs -I tests/host/compat -DFIXDIR='"${WORK}/fixtures"' $extra -Wno-error -I no-fuse -o ${WORK}/krffs_fuse_hosttest "$test" $deps

faults.name: ring
faults.summary: a mount that does not check the node ring before FUSE starts

lines: krffs-fuse-test: fail: oversized root rejected before fuse
krffs-fuse-test: fail: zero node size rejected before fuse

faults.name: parent
faults.summary: a child found by its name without its directory

lines: krffs-fuse-test: fail: staged file of the same name at the root reads

faults.name: moved
faults.summary: a node moved by its growth that loses its directory

lines: krffs-fuse-test: fail: moved file keeps its directory

faults.name: rename
faults.summary: a rename that leaves the node in its old directory

faults.name: mkdir-id
faults.summary: a mkdir without its refusal of a taken directory id

lines: krffs-fuse-test: fail: mkdir refuses a taken directory id

faults.name: owner
faults.summary: a node made with no FUSE request that keeps the free node's owner

lines: krffs-fuse-test: fail: no request gives the driver's owner
krffs-fuse-test: fail: free blocks rounded down

faults.name: statfs-avail
faults.summary: available blocks counted as every block of the image

lines: krffs-fuse-test: fail: full image has no free block

faults.name: same-name
faults.summary: a rename to the same name that frees the node

lines: krffs-fuse-test: fail: rename to the same name keeps the file

faults.name: staged-id

lines: krffs-fuse-test: fail: staged file has the hash of its name as its id
